lines.en: I carry a bottle and walk crooked.

lines.zh: 一脚深一脚浅，地不听话
lines.en: One foot deep, one shallow; the ground will not obey.

lines.zh: 我从酒馆的门里晃出来
lines.en: I sway out of the tavern door.
Wine has soaked my purple loincloth.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙走三步，滑一步
lines.en: I go three steps along the wall, then slide one.
I burp and laugh at myself.
The bottle sloshes in my hand.

lines.zh: 我对着月亮说了一句话
lines.en: I say something to the moon.
My ears hang loose and soft.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根柱子走了两圈
lines.en: I walk twice around a post.
I step on my own foot.
I switch the bottle to my left hand.
I sit against the tavern wall.

lines.zh: 我的头一点一点往下垂
lines.en: My head nods lower and lower.
The bottle stands by my leg.

lines.zh: 我抬起手又忘了要做什么
lines.en: I raise a hand and forget why.
Someone nearby sings off key.
I close my eyes a while.
Wine fumes drift off me.
I scratch my belly and grin slowly.
I stretch my legs, heels down.

lines.zh: 我对着空酒瓶看了一会儿
lines.en: I stare into the empty bottle.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼睛看你，看了两个
lines.en: I squint and see two of you.
You are so tall—or there are two of you.

lines.zh: 我抬起酒瓶朝你晃了晃
lines.en: I lift the bottle and tip it at you.
Will you have a drink?
I stand up, not quite straight.
I pat the ground beside me.
I am not drunk; I just walk slow.

lines.zh: 我把手在脸上抹了一把
lines.en: I wipe a hand across my face.
I lift a foot to go, then put it back.
I raise the empty bottle at you.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，酒醒了一半
lines.en: I yell, and half the drunk leaves me.
I stagger back half a step.

lines.zh: 我的手捂着头，酒瓶掉了
lines.en: I hold my head; the bottle drops.
I blink several times to focus.
I hold on to something to stay upright.
My wine spilled; it hurts.
I sit and shuffle backward.
I shake my head and my eyes clear a little.
I spit, and there is blood.
I haul myself up by the table leg.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，是下酒菜吗
lines.en: Is that something to drink with?

lines.zh: 我抓了一把空气往嘴里送
lines.en: I scoop at the air and put it to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在动，可手上是空的
lines.en: My mouth chews, but my hand is empty.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，摸了三次才摸到
lines.en: I reach out and miss three times.

lines.zh: 我们分着喝，别一个人喝
lines.en: Let us share the drink.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，觉得是好东西
lines.en: I sniff it and decide it is good.
I stretch my neck out far.
My hand waves before you.
I grin, all teeth showing.
I drink first; do as you like.
I hit you and the wine spills.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣服才站稳
lines.en: I grab your clothes to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我笑出声
lines.en: We collide and I burst out laughing.
My bottle rolls on the ground.

lines.zh: 我伸手去扶你，扶了个空
lines.en: I reach to steady you and catch nothing.
I land on my backside.
I pull myself up by the table corner.
We knock the table swaying.
The wine spreads across the floor.

lines.zh: 我们在门框里卡了一下
lines.en: We wedge in the door frame a moment.
She is drunk too; her face is red.

lines.zh: 我们两个靠着同一面墙
lines.en: We lean on the same wall.

lines.zh: 她把我的酒瓶拿走喝了一口
lines.en: She takes my bottle and drinks.

lines.zh: 我们一起唱歌，跑调跑一块
lines.en: We sing together, off key together.

lines.zh: 她把头搁在我肩上，睡着了
lines.en: She rests her head on my shoulder and sleeps.

lines.zh: 她把我的头推到另一边
lines.en: She tips my head the other way.
We both burp at once.
She says my singing is awful.

lines.zh: 我们一起笑得直不起腰
lines.en: We laugh until we cannot straighten.
She hides the bottle behind her back.
I bend and nearly topple.

lines.zh: 我摸了两次才把东西拿起来
lines.en: I feel twice before picking it up.
It is my bottle; I know it.
I hug the bottle to my chest.

lines.zh: 地上还有一点，我抹了抹
lines.en: There is a little left; I wipe it up.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，一头撞到桌腿
lines.en: I squat and bang my head on a table leg.
I feel it and cannot grip.
I pick it up, very carefully.
I pick up the shards one by one.
I sit on the floor and pick slowly.

lines.zh: 我把酒瓶放下，慢慢站起来
lines.en: I set the bottle down and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 我的眼从酒里对上了你
lines.en: My eyes find you through the wine.
My head is crooked, but I see clearly.

lines.zh: 酒馆里的人都在看我们
lines.en: Everyone in the tavern is watching us.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人站着看我
lines.en: I do not like being looked down on.
I set the bottle down steady.

lines.zh: 我吐了一口气，酒味很重
lines.en: I breathe out; the wine is strong.
I roll my sleeves up.
The tavern has gone a little quiet.
I wipe my mouth with the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 我站起来，桌子被我推开了
lines.en: I stand and the table slides away.
I spit on the floor.

lines.zh: 我的拳头握不紧，可我能撞
lines.en: My fist will not close, but I can charge.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚，一个变两个
lines.en: I count your feet; one becomes two.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，撞翻一把椅子
lines.en: I come at you, knocking a chair over.
I do not fear pain; I have drunk.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地走近，走不稳
lines.en: I come closer step by step, unsteady.

lines.zh: 我抬手比了比你的方向
lines.en: I raise a hand to measure your direction.
Are you swaying, or am I?
I crush an empty jug underfoot.
I say nothing and keep walking.

lines.zh: 我的酒劲上来了，手更稳
lines.en: The wine is in me now; my hands are steadier.
I turn with you and hit the wall.
I lick my lips and lose my footing.

lines.zh: 你在桌子的那边，我在这边
lines.en: You are across the table; I am here.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，桌子挡路
lines.en: I shuffle forward; the table is in the way.
I kick a chair aside.
I point at you, twice.
I laugh, and laugh a little too long.
I go around along the wall.
My breathing is heavy and loud.
I stare at you, my eyes a little red.
I miss a step and catch myself.

lines.zh: 你退到门边，我不让你出
lines.en: You back to the door; I will not let you out.
I tuck my loincloth in tight.

lines.zh: 我舔了下拳头，像在试味
lines.en: I lick my fist as if tasting it.

lines.zh: 我一拳挥出去，差点摔倒
lines.en: I swing a fist and nearly fall over.
The bottle breaks on your shoulder.
I lunge and grab your leg.
I bite hard once.

lines.zh: 我打了个酒嗝，接着又扑
lines.en: I hiccup and lunge again.
I ram my head into your stomach.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往下拽
lines.en: I grab your collar and pull down.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落在你肩上，很沉
lines.en: My fist lands on your shoulder, heavy.
I kick and miss.
I shove the whole table at you.

lines.zh: 我扑在你身上，两个人一起倒
lines.en: I lunge and we both go down.
I drive my elbow into your chest.
I bite your sleeve and hold.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃，还是打中了
lines.en: I sway, and still connect.
I stamp on your foot.
My punch goes wide into the wall.
I charge while you are off balance.
Another of my bottles breaks.
After the blow I sit down myself.

lines.zh: 我咧着嘴，血从嘴角下来
lines.en: I grin, blood at the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 酒馆的门被我一脚踢开
lines.en: I kick the tavern door open.
Half a bottle is still in my hand.
I sway twice before standing firm.
The drinkers look up at me.
I cinch my loincloth tighter.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过来，脚步很响
lines.en: I come toward you, footsteps loud.

lines.zh: 我抱着酒瓶从后屋出来
lines.en: I come out of the back room with a bottle.
I lean on the door frame to steady myself.
I have spilled wine all the way here.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看这屋子，转了一圈
lines.en: I look around the room, turning.

lines.zh: 有人从桌上抬起头看我
lines.en: Someone at a table lifts his head.
I raise the bottle at the room.

lines.zh: 酒在我身上烧起来，我扑打
lines.en: The wine burns on me and I beat at it.

lines.zh: 我一头栽下去，脸先着地
lines.en: I pitch forward, face first.

lines.zh: 我呛了一口，全是酒味的水
lines.en: I choke on water that tastes of wine.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀到桌子底下
lines.en: The blast throws me under a table.

lines.zh: 一根箭插在我肩上，我还笑着
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and I am still grinning.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我一阵天旋地转
lines.en: That force spins the world around me.

lines.zh: 空腹喝酒，胃里烧得难受
lines.en: Drinking on an empty stomach burns.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的酒全醒了
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the wine leaves me all at once.

lines.zh: 地没了，我抱着酒瓶往下掉
lines.en: No floor; I fall clutching the bottle.
